audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven chart rows disagreed with their own prose and with the packet chart. Both layers said Lucian owns levels 2-5 while whys[2] and whys[3] describe Garen spin-tanking the trade.
audit.why: Packet chart reads Lucian, Skill, Garen, Garen, Skill, Garen, Skill, and the already-audited mirror flipped its rows 2, 3, 5 and 6 to that same chart. Our side was still inverted, which would have contradicted the mirror on four rows.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-6 brought onto the packet chart as one atomic group: win[N] and phases[N].side together, ratings inverted, and phases[N].why rewritten so each row's reason matches the side it now shows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Courage was described only as 'damage reduction on cast'; its shield and its 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s cooldown were never given.
audit.why: Courage gives a shield AND tenacity AND a longer damage-reduction tail. The shield is what eats a Lightslinger burst, and the 22s rank-1 downtime is the only clean window in the lane. Without the number the advice is unactionable.
audit.corrected: report[5].t, spikes[1].text, phases[3].why and mid now carry the shield and the 22s figure.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. Decisive Strike's auto-reset was never mentioned, and both whys[5] and late claim Garen's tenacity 'shrugs your Ardent Blaze slow'.
audit.why: Ardent Blaze marks and reveals enemies and grants Lucian move speed for attacking marked targets — Riot's text contains no slow. A player planning around a slow that does not exist will mistime the kite. Decisive Strike IS an auto reset, so the wind-up rather than the cast is the cue to step back.
audit.corrected: The phantom slow removed from whys[5] and late; the auto-reset tell written into early, spikes[1].text and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: early, mid and late were written in the first person ('mine', 'my auto range', 'I Q-cast').
audit.why: Every other field on the page is second person. The voice break reads as a different author and undercuts the coaching tone.
audit.corrected: All three rewritten in second person, same length band.

audit.why: The three suspectNames flagged in the packet (Ardent Blaze, Decisive Strike, Demacian Justice) are all correct against the kit files — false positives, no change made.

edits.before: E online — dash-weave trades start now: spell, double-shot, dash out before his answer lands.
edits.after: E online, but Decisive Strike silences your cast on an 8s cooldown — trade around it and level 2 is even.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-AA-E-AA-W-AA strings chunk a third of his HP. Trade on every CS he takes from the wrong angle.
edits.after: Courage shields and cuts your burst while Judgment shreds you in melee — he spin-tanks the trade at 3.

edits.before: Keep the pressure rolling but track Courage — your lead is HP-bar bullying, not all-in math, until items arrive.
edits.after: Courage is down 22s at rank 1 — that gap is your only clean burst; outside it Perseverance regen erases the poke.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: The Culling kite-executes, but Demacian Justice is true damage on 120s — even, and lethal in both directions.

edits.before: First item spike is your kill window — the dash-weave combo now deletes half bars. Force the issue before he stabilizes.
edits.after: His bruiser first item out-stats your one ADC buy — Courage tenacity blunts your CC and Perseverance refunds your poke.

edits.before: You fall off relative to top-lane scalers — convert the lead into towers and roams before the 3-item brawlers arrive.
edits.after: It evens out in fights — dashes and The Culling keep you relevant, but never take a straight sidelane duel with him.

edits.before: His first-item bruiser spike out-stats your single ADC item — W tenacity shrugs your Ardent Blaze slow and his sustained DPS plus regen beats your burst when E is down.
edits.after: His first-item bruiser spike out-stats your single ADC item — Ardent Blaze only marks and speeds you, it never slowed him, and his DPS plus regen beats your burst when E is down.

edits.before: Garen's spike: with Q-W-E up his Courage damage-reduction and silence-strike let him spin-tank your trade and walk you down once W is active.
edits.after: Garen's spike: Courage (22s) shields and reduces damage while Judgment shreds you — and Decisive Strike is an auto reset, so the wind-up is the tell.

edits.before: Track Garen’s Courage: Damage reduction on cast — your burst only lands full once it is down. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Courage (22s at rank 1): the shield and damage reduction eat your burst, so bait it first. Decisive Strike's wind-up is an auto reset.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are mine: my auto range plus the Lightslinger double-tap means every time Garen steps up to last-hit, I Q-cast and land two shots before his Decisive Strike (Q) can close the gap and silence me. Hold your ground at max range and punish — at level 1 he has only the silence-strike and no Courage to cut my damage yet. The one thing to dodge is the silence: don't be mid-ability-cast when he dashes in, because that Q cancels my cast and an empowered Decisive Strike auto hurts. Keep weaving W marks and chipping.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are yours: your auto range plus the Lightslinger double-tap means every time Garen steps up to last-hit, you Q-cast and land two shots before Decisive Strike (Q) can close the gap and silence you. Hold max range and punish — at level 1 he has only the silence-strike and no Courage to cut your damage. The one thing to dodge is that silence: don't be mid-cast when he steps in, because it cancels the cast and the empowered strike is an auto reset, so the wind-up is your cue to back off.

edits.before: Level 3 is where it tilts to him — once Garen has Judgment (E) spin and Courage (W) up, he can pop the damage reduction and tenacity, soak my Lightslinger burst, and walk through my kite while Judgment shreds me in melee. Don't stand in the spin. From 4-5 keep using Ardent Blaze (W) for the move-speed proc and Relentless Pursuit (E) to dash out of his silence range — trade in short Q-double-tap bursts and immediately reposition, never sit in his Judgment. At 6 it's a real coin-flip: my movable Culling channel can kite-execute him, but his Demacian Justice true-damage execute punishes my low base HP the instant I'm caught, so respect his all-in threshold.
edits.after: Level 3 is where it tilts to him — once Garen has Judgment (E) and Courage (W) up he pops a shield, damage reduction and tenacity, soaks your Lightslinger burst, and walks through your kite while Judgment shreds you in melee. Don't stand in the spin. From 4-5 use Ardent Blaze (W) for the move-speed proc and Relentless Pursuit (E) to leave his silence range — trade in short Q-double-tap bursts and reposition, never sit in Judgment. Courage is down 22s at rank 1, and that gap is the only time your burst lands whole. At 6 it's a real coin-flip: your movable Culling can kite-execute him, but Demacian Justice is true damage into your low base HP the instant he catches you.

edits.before: Past first item the lane slides to Garen — his W tenacity shrugs my Ardent Blaze slow, his passive regen heals my poke when he steps out of vision, and his sustained bruiser DPS plus a single tank item out-stat my one ADC purchase once Relentless Pursuit is on cooldown. I'm a weak scaler for the role and he isn't, so I have to cash my levels 1-2 auto-range lead into a kill or a CS/plate advantage early. Late game I stop trying to solo-duel him — I kite in teamfights where my Culling executes a focused target and my dashes keep me out of his Judgment, and let his low range and lack of engage make him the one struggling to reach me.
edits.after: Past first item the lane slides to Garen — Courage's tenacity blunts your CC, Perseverance regen heals your poke the moment he steps out of vision, and his bruiser DPS plus one tank item out-stat your single ADC purchase once Relentless Pursuit is down. Ardent Blaze marks and speeds you; it never slowed him, so do not plan a kite around a slow. You're a weak scaler for the role and he isn't, so cash the levels 1-2 auto-range lead into a kill or a CS and plate lead early. Late you stop solo-duelling — kite in teamfights where The Culling executes a focused target and your dashes keep you clear of Judgment, and let his 300-range Q strand him.
